q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a folding carton?
title: Folding carton carbon footprint per kg
short: Take the board mill's figure for the duplex or SBS board, add inks, varnish, lamination film and adhesive, then add printing, coating, die cutting and gluing energy per kg of cartons dispatched.
audience: Mono carton and folding carton converters

ul: Printing inks and varnish or UV coating.
Lamination film, foil and glue if used.
Die cutting, stripping and folder gluing.

p: Report per kg, or per carton by size and board weight. Lamination and foil add to the board figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 50,000 = 0.426 kg CO2 per kg
Add board, ink and coatings for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
